pages.text: Look in Sand Hills, Limestone Crags, or Limestone Mountains. Offer bones, raw rabbit, or cooked rabbit until a wolf accepts you. Regular tamed wolves can sit and follow. The larger alpha can be ridden.

Sneak and use a tamed alpha to open its inventory. Add a saddle and optional Desert Wolf Armor. While riding, open your inventory to reach the wolf’s equipment. It has equipment slots for saddle and armor.
A wounded tamed wolf can be fed meat. Dye the collar to tell your companions apart. Watch out around wild wolves and keep camels clear when the pack is hostile.
